# P3 implementation plan — docked right rail, FAB as collapsed affordance, Studio reflow

Per the decisions locked 2026-07-13 (recorded in the ADR): **chat docks right** (Studio properties fold into a center tab) and **the FAB survives as the dock's collapsed affordance**. Three reversible sub-phases, each its own PR with an ADR-0054 browser proof.

## P3a — `ChatDock` shell (additive; no entry-point changes)
**New**: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDock.tsx` + `hooks/useChatDockState.ts`
- Right-side rail in `ConsoleLayout` (flex row beside main): collapsible, **default collapsed**, drag-resizable (min 360px / max 50vw, width persisted to localStorage), full-screen sheet under the `md` breakpoint.
- Renders the existing `ChatPane` body (already exported from `AiChatPage`) over the P1 conversation key — the dock is a VIEW; no new conversation state.
- Gate: `useAiSurface` (catalog empty → no dock, OSS unchanged). Keyboard toggle ⌘I.
- **Feature flag** `features.chatDock` (default off in prod) = the rollback lever for the whole phase.
- *Proof*: dock opens on any console page; collapse/expand preserves the thread id; OSS build shows nothing.

## P3b — FAB → collapsed affordance; overlay retires
**Touched**: `layout/ConsoleChatbotFab.tsx`, `layout/ConsoleFloatingChatbot.tsx`, `assistant/assistantBus.ts`
- FAB click toggles the dock (no more floating overlay in the console); `FloatingChatbot` the component stays for the runtime SDUI bubble (audience idiom, per ADR §4).
- `assistantBus` open/context/review signals re-point to the dock.
- **Sub-task (flagged risk)**: the FAB still keys its conversation per-agent (`scope: activeAgent`, `ConsoleFloatingChatbot.tsx:961`) — migrate to the P1 `chatConversationScope` key with a one-time fallback read of the legacy scope, so existing FAB threads don't vanish for users.
- *Proof*: FAB opens the dock showing the SAME thread as `/ai/ask`; reconcile-on-error + HITL cards function inside the dock; no overlay remains.

## P3c — `/ai` = maximized dock; Studio right-side reflow
**Touched**: `console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (becomes a thin route wrapper: sidebar + maximized dock body), `views/studio-design/StudioAiCopilot.tsx` (leaves the left `w-96 border-r` slot), `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (grid → `[left: nav/tree] [center: canvas + properties tabs] [right: dock]`)
- Deep links `/ai/:agent/:conversationId` (share links, ADR-0013) open the dock maximized on that thread — routing unchanged.
- Live Canvas (ADR-0037) renders beside the chat in maximized mode, unchanged in the rail (canvas needs width → auto-maximize on canvas open, tuck on close; reuse the existing `onCanvasOpenChange` seam).
- *Proof*: one app's build thread is IDENTICAL across dock / `/ai/build` / Studio copilot (P1 key, the ADR's headline fix); Studio properties reachable via center tab; canvas opens beside chat.

## Sequencing & estimates
P3a (~1d) → P3b (~1d, scope migration is the risk) → P3c (~2d, Studio reflow is the risk). Flag stays until P3c proves out, then the flag + dead overlay code are removed in a cleanup PR.

## Pre-existing seams this leans on (verified in-repo today)
- `ChatPane` already exported and reused by Studio (P1); `chatConversationScope` keying (P1); `resolveSurfaceAgent` (P2); `useAiSurface` gate; `agentHasCapability` (cloud#816, just landed) so the dock renders debug/canvas/resume behavior by declared capability from day one.
